summary.text: Phil Rubin is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 40 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Phil Rubin was appointed to the North Carolina House on January 29, 2025, succeeding Joe John in District 40.
The Democratic primary for the seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
